Step 1: 1599 is not a leap year (divisible by 4 but also by 100 and not by 400).  
Step 2: Days from Apr 28 to end of April: 2 days (Apr 29, 30).  
Step 3: Add remaining 181 days (183 - 2 = 181).  
May (31) → 151 left, June (30) → 121 left, July (31) → 90 left,  
August (31) → 59 left, September (30) → 29 left, October 29 days lands on Oct 29.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1599-10-29
